correctness.rationale: PASS: For y³-y=x²+x+1/x over F3 the projective homogenization XY³-XYZ²-X³Z-X²Z²-Z⁴ defines a smooth quartic: affine partial derivative in Y is -X at X≠0, and both points at infinity are smooth with nonzero Z or X derivative. It has genus three, two F_(3^n)-rational points above poles, and #C(F_(3^n))=2+3#{x≠0:Tr(x²+x+x^-1)=0}. Independent polynomial-basis computations over F3,F9,F27 reproduce counts 5,17,44, giving Frobenius power sums -1,-7,-16. Newton identities + genus-3 Weil reciprocal functional equation force P(T)=1+T+4T²+9T³+12T⁴+9T⁵+27T⁶=(1-T+3T²)^2(1+3T+3T²). Elliptic F3 curves with traces 1 and -3 give ordinary and supersingular factors by Tate; P(1)=63. Factorization independently verified. No claim of polarized isomorphism.
residual_risks: One explicit F3 curve; does not classify twists, identify Jacobian up to isomorphism or polarizations.
